title: Infested Craft
description: This pack adds crafting recipes for all of the infested blocks.
body:
![Minecraft title text. The top is grey, saying infested craft. The bottom is blue, saying abyssal vanguard.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/106dfc78cb1c63dfa5087635c84592e5b74605ff.png)
## Craft Infested Blocks
This datapack adds a crafting recipe for infested blocks. Whether you're pranking your friends with a trap, making puzzles, or using the blocks for mining, infested blocks are a hidden gem in the creative menu. With this pack, you'll be able to use them in your survival world.

### Why This Matters
Unlock More Functionality: Use infested blocks to your heart's content, for mining, trapping, or minigames!
Balanced: The recipe is balanced, and the block isn't too overpowered, so you don't have to worry about unfair gameplay!
Multiplayer-Safe: The pack is lightweight and perfect for use in an SMP with your friends. Have fun making impenetrable defenses!

### Compatibility
Works with 1.21 and newer
Compatible with most datapacks and mods

This pack is perfect if you like to incorporate unobtainable blocks in a balanced way.

Made by MeowingChip5
